messages.subject: coding question - higher order predictors
parts:
Hello:

I have a question about how to code a particular type of higher order interaction. Basically, I have latent variables that represent behavioral classes (e.g. aggression, courtship) which have specific predictors (scores based on specific behaviors). So the model structure (simplified) is something like this:

aggression =~ x1 + x2 + x3
courtship =~ x4 + x5 + x6 + x7
escape =~ x8 +x9 +x10 

I can get this to run and it looks pretty good. What I would like to do now is ask whether hormones influence the latent behavioral classes. So for example, do testosterone levels predict all latent variable or only aggression and courtship? I'm not sure how to do this because the hormones levels are something that I measured, not a higher order latent variable (i.e. I want to ask if the effect is causal). I've know I can just include the hormones as another set of predictors for multiple latent variable, but I'm not sure this is the appropriate strategy.

Any help on how to code this properly is great appreciated!
eva

On 05/06/2014 05:12 PM, Eva Fischer wrote:
> Hello:
>
> I have a question about how to code a particular type of higher order
> interaction. Basically, I have latent variables that represent
> behavioral classes (e.g. aggression, courtship) which have specific
> predictors (scores based on specific behaviors). So the model structure
> (simplified) is something like this:
>
> aggression =~ x1 + x2 + x3
> courtship =~ x4 + x5 + x6 + x7
> escape =~ x8 +x9 +x10
>
> I can get this to run and it looks pretty good. What I would like to do
> now is ask whether hormones influence the latent behavioral classes. So
> for example, do testosterone levels predict all latent variable or only
> aggression and courtship? I'm not sure how to do this because the
> hormones levels are something that I measured, not a higher order latent
> variable

It sounds to me that you would like to regress the latent variables on
your (observed) hormones variable(s). Say that are called 'hormon1' and
'hormon2', you can use:

aggression ~ hormon1 + hormon2
courtship ~ hormon1 + hormon2
escape ~ hormon1 + hormon2

Yves.
